name_input: UNI TRITECH PRIVATE LIMITED; UNI-VTL Precision Pvt. Ltd
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'uni-tritech-private-limited' shows "Total Shipments 2267 Records detected", "Trading Partners 24", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | UNI TRITECH PRIVATE LIMITED | TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS LTD | ALLUMINIUM CASTINGS Machined Connector - Rib 8 D282 50025 002PF- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Wrexham, UNITED KINGDOM | 76090000 | 1116957". Further rows seen: 2026-02-27 (BOL 1102127, HS 76090000, Barnstaple UK); 2026-02-21 (BOL 9896303, HS 73259930, New York USA, buyer GOODRICH CORP); 2026-02-20 (BOL 9842501, HS 76090000, Liverpool UK, buyer TRIUMPH AEROSPACE OPERATIONS). Source counter vs rows actually seen: page claims 2267 shipments / 24 partners; only 5 shipment rows were rendered in the free view (counter >> visible rows, so the 2267 figure is the site's own claim, not independently counted). Buyer breakdown shown: TRITECH GROUP (SITE C) 996, TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS LTD 574, TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS LIMITED 247, TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS 70, TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS LTD 68.
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits were not accessible: web_search backend returned 'searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>' on all queries, and thecompanycheck.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic turnover = null, not estimated. Note: the customs rows themselves show the Indian entity acting as shipper/exporter from Nhava Sheva Sea and Bangalore ACC, i.e. outbound flows only; no India-to-India consignment or GST-based evidence was seen.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: shipments on 2026-02-20, 2026-02-21, 2026-02-27 and 2026-02-28 to the UK (Wrexham, Barnstaple, Liverpool) and USA (New York), with B/L numbers 9842501, 9896303, 1102127, 1116957. Counterparty is the UK group company TRITECH PRECISION PRODUCTS LTD / TRITECH GROUP (SITE C), so a large share of the flow is intra-group. HS DISCREPANCY (per project rule 3, not a rejection ground): declared HS 845710 (machining centres for working metal) does not match the observed records, which are aluminium castings/machined aerospace parts under HS 76090000 (aluminium tube/pipe fittings) and 73259930 (other cast articles of iron/steel); the actual code should be corrected to 76090000 / 73259930 and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is imprecise — the records show an aluminium/steel investment-casting and precision-machining supplier to aerospace (Goodrich/Collins, Triumph), not mining. Second entity UNI-VTL Precision Pvt. Ltd: both slug variants ('uni-vtl-precision-private-limited', 'uni-vtl-precision-pvt-ltd') returned pages with zero shipment rows and no counters, so no shipment evidence for that specific legal entity — status for it would be none_found, not confirmed; it may be a renamed/merged or dormant vehicle. Revenue and export value: null — ImportKey free view shows no values, only quantities/descriptions, and no figures were invented. No sanctions/court data was assessed (out of scope for this role).
